observations: App supplies existing FlowClient reader/writer privately to AppPluginSession. Plugin definitions do not gain public client/token access.

Stable useMemo port carries retained namespace and live ConnectionSession generation. active flag is updated in layout effect before session updateActions; each command/read checks current authority, not only render-time authorized.

Session owns one runtime command controller outside lazy Settings. Normal unchanged authority and observer unmount do not recreate it; changed authority revokes current controller and creates a fresh generation.
Settings is a subscriber; close/collapse/local browser extension changes do not own controller lifetime. Center desired-enabled does not deactivate local host, dispose drafts or cancel center jobs.
Read wrappers reject late results across authority change; runtime controller existing isCurrent/revoke guard handles late writes and original idempotency key/body retention.
Existing Module/Interface and stable external-store subscription functions reused; no new transport, command FSM or cache system.
The production patch leaves official Thread, single Composer ownership, attachment membership selector, message settings draft adapter and recovery source unchanged.

Browser check explicitly uses ?recovery to choose actual BrowserWorkspace despite VITE_FLOW_FIXTURE:true; synthetic Cookie/CSRF HTTP adapter forwards internally to a legacy fixture. It does not establish real center auth/runner execution.

Proposed four browser groups cover current complete draft with settings/ordered references, unknown retry across lazy disclosure, active workspace loss/late completion and 390px two-theme focus. Runtime behavior remains unexecuted at this note.
